entries.2f8ebd5c30216220: The company secures food raw material supply bases in Japan and overseas and has built a system to supply safe and secure products to food manufacturers and others in a timely and stable manner. Focusing on areas that conventional trading companies had not handled, including commercial pasteurized milk for coffee beverages and similar products, where powdered skim milk had once been the mainstream, the company has built its supply system and made these its core products. The company also carries out joint development of new products with its business partners and, as a food manufacturer, develops and proposes products that match its business partners' needs.

entries.ffd88a235855642c: The reportable segments are two: the wholesale business (net sales to external customers of ¥35,306 million) and the manufacturing and sales business (¥6,602 million), with the wholesale business accounting for the majority. As net sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of the total, the disclosure of net sales by region has been omitted. Its main customer is Ito En, Ltd., which is listed as a customer of the wholesale business. The company explains that in the food and beverage industry, price increases following soaring raw material prices and rising personnel costs have strengthened consumers' tendency to save money.
